newsitem.title: USA: USX-Delhi expands Pinnacle Reef capacity.
newsitem.headline: USX-Delhi expands Pinnacle Reef capacity.

text.p: USX-Delhi Group said it has completed the first stage in its East Texas Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef expansion program.

New facilities were placed in operation earlier this month add 100 million cubic feet per day of natural gas gathering and treating capacity to the 60 million cubic feet built in late 1995 as part of Delhi's East Texas Gathering System. Phase
II will add a total of 275 million feet of capacity to move sour natural gas from these wells to its Aker Treating Plant, spokesman Mike Dixon said Wednesday.
